notes.purpose: Single machine-readable release-train authority. A requested release version selects one train; that train names its own authority parent, its closeable mandatory children, the evidence it requires, the cross-version references it consumes, its conditional items and its declared non-blockers.
notes.replaces: This file replaces the former .github/release/v1-mandatory-issues.json, whose entire content is carried by the 1.0.0.0 train below. There is deliberately no second active authority.
notes.semantics: Version digits identify coherent product states and never encode frontend, platform, Qt family, UI family or CI lane. A train that is merely representable never blocks an earlier train, and the number 1.2.0.0 existing does not authorize it.
notes.fail_closed: Unknown versions, retired planning labels, records whose mandatory_children are absent or empty while the train is active, and note keys that belong to no classified list all fail selection instead of answering.

conditional_trains.rule: Conditional by activation evidence, not by the number existing. It becomes selectable only when its activation authority records activation, at which point a train record is added here and in trains.

notes.232: Closed before this migration; the release gate reads its live state like any other mandatory child.
notes.209: Cross-version umbrella. Referenced for the evidence this train consumes; the whole umbrella is never a V0.1 closeable requirement.

0.1.0.0.rule: The V0.1 user promise is the release authority. Later-train work and cross-version umbrellas are referenced, never required to close.

0.2.0.0.rule: Representable and selectable so it never blocks an earlier train. Its mandatory slices are populated by its own authority issue, never invented here.

0.3.0.0.rule: Representable and selectable. Mandatory slices belong to its own authority issue.

0.4.0.0.rule: Release Candidate line. V0.4.0.x maintenance releases stay inside this train.

notes.57: V1 requires an evidence-backed qualification disposition; this does not automatically promote every Qt line to Supported.
